id: title:Gilbert09:point to try again after granting webhook write access

review.posthog_relevance: Stripe warehouse source setup UX improvement
review.reason: The change replaces a Stripe permission-denied error message with a more actionable one, including specific instructions on adding 'Write' permission or creating the webhook manually. This is a localized, bounded improvement to the warehouse setup experience.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to UX clarity; no systemic reliability, security, or broader capability changes are demonstrated. The score does not account for unverified adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains three hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F3.H1 are related: P1.F3.H1 is an end-to-end test asserting the exact error string changed in P1.F1.H1. P1.F2.H1 is a unit test for the same permission error, also updated to match the new string. All three hunks belong to a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present.

observations.behavior: Replaced the Stripe permission-denied error message with a new, more actionable message.
observations.code_quote: error="Your Stripe API key doesn't have permission to create webhooks. Please add the 'Write' permission for 'Webhook endpoints' to your API key, or create the webhook manually.",
observations.posthog_connection: Stripe is a warehouse source; this change improves the UX for warehouse setup, not query or identity. The implementation is a localized string replacement in the Stripe webhook creation path.
